published_implementation.historical_relation: Octobench and Octomind are published by Muvon. The pinned benchmark invokes `octomind run developer --format=jsonl` with committed benchmark-specific Octomind configuration and uses the native client loop. The exact Octomind binary version or repository revision used for the published GOLD one-shot columns is not established by the committed one-shot result surface, so no canonical historical linkage is asserted.

result.model_config: Octobench model key gpt-5.6-luna maps Octomind to openai:gpt-5.6-luna; exact provider endpoint/checkpoint revision and run-time Octomind binary pin are not exposed in the committed one-shot result table
result.execution_environment: Octobench Docker executor using image tag octobench-agent:latest; shared committed system prompt; network sealed after setup; clean workspace enabled; GitHub unreachable from the agent container; exact image digest is not published
result.evaluator: project-specific held-out GOLD validation determines pass/fail; BENCHMARK.md also publishes a judge average produced by Octobench's audited judge-panel path; exact run-time judge override is not exposed in the committed aggregate result
result.budget_timeout_repetition_policy: exact per-case timeout and one-shot rerun history for this published aggregate are not established by the committed result table; the benchmark launcher exposes controlled reruns for infrastructure failures
result.adaptation_reset_policy: persistent cross-case memory is disabled by benchmark design; clean workspace is required per run; native client scaffolding, planning primitives and step/turn ceilings remain client-specific residuals

observations.notes: No canonical harness ID is assigned because W1 found no current canonical Octomind assessment and does not create one. First-party publication status is preserved separately from later comparison-quality or historical-linkage review.
